notesHtml:
Julia sets herself goals, and then plans backwards on how to achieve them. One of those goals was to complete the Bright Midnight Norway Race. An ultra biking event of 1100km and 20'000 meters of elevation. She completed it in 3 days and 18 hours. Curious how she managed to prepare her mind and body for this, and other challenges? Check out this episode!
